description: For each stock token on Borro: the stock's own price (its Chainlink feed while the market is open; Borro's weekend estimate and 95% band while it is shut), the token's executable buy and sell price on chain for $1,000 and $10,000 (what Borro's short desk would pay or get through its own swap route, before Borro's fee), and the gap in percent (gapPct: the token's mid against the stock). Positive: the token trades over the stock (short it on Borro); negative: under it (buy and lend it). Refreshed every 30 seconds; the same as https://borro.markets/prices.json.
name: prices
title: Stock tokens against the stock
